capabilities: Read and modify files, run shell commands, inspect images, and manage background processes.
description:
Type into a running background command and read what it prints back.

Use it to answer a prompt, drive a REPL, or interrupt with Ctrl-C ("\u0003"). End a line with a newline, the way you would when typing. Only the output that arrived since your last read comes back.

input.description: Characters to send. Use "\u0003" for Ctrl-C, which interrupts without ending the command.

task_id.description: Task ID of the running background command.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for output afterwards. Defaults to 250ms.

name: send_command_input
